title: Orbit setup texts
description: Every string `orbit setup` writes into an assistant's files: the managed instruction block, the two hook nudges, and the values filling {{name}} placeholders in assistant templates. Read by crates/orbit-cli/src/commands/setup/spec.rs.

instructions.description: Markdown spliced into each assistant's instruction file between the orbit:setup markers.

nudge_search.description: Context the hook guard returns for a search tool call.

nudge_read.description: Context the hook guard returns for a source-file read.

template_vars.description: Values substituted for {{name}} placeholders in the templates assistants declare. They reach a shell echo, so they must not contain quotes, backticks, or $(.
